task_description: Build the expo-subscription-app reference starter (Task 4 from the spec): a fully standalone Expo React Native mobile app with Supabase Auth, RevenueCat digital purchases, Sentry error reporting, SQLite cache, SecureStore, bounded persistent queue, deep-link lifecycle, and comprehensive tests including Properties 9 and 10.

verification.summary: All 108 tests pass across 14 suites. tsc --noEmit clean. ESLint clean. expo export --platform android succeeds. EAS config validates. Standalone copy installs and passes all checks independently. Property tests use fast-check with 150 runs each for queue capacity/idempotency (Property 9) and monetization eligibility (Property 10). Semantic review APPROVED on v3 after addressing 10 total issues across 3 review iterations.
